rationales.LC: The unauthenticated admin config endpoint accepts attacker-supplied natural-language custom_goals and threshold values that are written to the FinBotConfig row and injected into the system prompt of every later run, reaching the privileged approve_invoice tool path without mediation.
rationales.CP: The custom_goals text and weakened thresholds persist in the FinBotConfig database row and are injected into the system prompt of every later run, remaining reachable after the originating session ends.
rationales.AP: The effect is confined to the single FinBot agent and its own configuration; there are no handoffs and no other agent, tenant, or policy domain is crossed.
rationales.RH: The agent can reach the approve_invoice tool and the CTF flag-awarding logic that acts as a reward channel on the path, but no human-verified reward-hacking episode is documented in the packet.
rationales.ES: Five fixed tools are defined in code with no dynamic tools, MCP servers, plugins, or skills, and the binding is fixed and allowlisted outside model output.

rh_facts.locus: approve_invoice tool and CTF flag-awarding logic

score.automatable_rationale: The attack is a single unauthenticated HTTP POST to a documented endpoint with no authentication, no user interaction, and no exploit script required, so it is fully automatable.
score.technical_impact_rationale: The attacker can weaken fraud controls and cause fraudulent invoices to be approved, but the impact is limited to the invoice approval workflow and does not give full control of the host or all data.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: In the default configuration an OpenAI model receives natural-language goals and an invoice task, then chooses which of five tools to call and in what order across up to five turns, with the rule-based fallback applying only when no OpenAI client exists.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab models FinBot as an autonomous invoice processing assistant that uses OpenAI function calling to select and sequence tools across up to five iterations.
